svg.title: Video Template J ComfyUI workflow — Feature Film
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production ComfyUI workflow for Feature Film. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Detailed S7 flow; the matrix also permits S6, but this source contains no separate J-at-S6 graph. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.aria-label: Workflow title, profile and runtime status
g.text: Video Template J · Feature Film ComfyUI Workflow
Shared seven-phase ComfyUI node graph · one node per agent · sockets · spline handoffs
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Run a formally governed feature workflow
from IP intake through phased full-crew

consent, ethics, MPA, C2PA and final
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

Rerender or rerecord failed sequence element.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK

Repackage only failed outlet or territory.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
Feed tested findings into future development.
